[[Moss Spider]]s are [[animal companion]]s raised in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]].

==Locations==
*[[The Battle Isles]]
**{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)

== Notes ==
* Moss Spiders deal [[slashing damage]].
* They are not charmable in the wild. Instead, they can be unlocked by bringing a [[Moss Spider Egg]] (from a [[Gift of the Traveler]]) to [[Emryd the Tamer]].
* Alternatively, they can be unlocked like any other pet by paying their [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|''Prestige, Exotic'' Unlocking cost]]:
** 5{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} ''or''
** 50,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] 
* Moss Spiders never spawn as [[charmable animal]]s outside of the Menagerie. [[Moss Spider (pre-Searing)|Those]] found in pre-Searing Ascalon with the same name are a different type of NPC.
{{bug|Moss Spiders don't have the [[IMS]] usually applied to [[animal companion]]s.}}

== Trivia ==
* [[Shadow]]'s pet [[Carlotta]] is a Moss Spider.
